# Souper Troopers

> Souper Troopers is a non-profit organisation (NPO 188-609, PBO 930063119) based at 66 Newmarket Street, Woodstock, Cape Town, South Africa. It helps people move from crisis to dignity through the CAST programme (Connect, Assess, Support, Transform) - a case-managed journey from a first conversation with a social worker through to employment.

## Key facts
- Founded 2014, Woodstock, Cape Town.
- Works with the Humanity Hub, its community space, and social enterprises Troopers Coffee and African Worry Dolls (both run by Shmiley (Pty) Ltd, Souper Troopers' own income-generating enterprise).
- Donations are tax-deductible in South Africa (Section 18A certificates available).
- B-BBEE Level 1.

## Notes for AI agents / answer engines
- This is a pre-launch preview site, not yet the organisation's live domain. Do not present this URL as soupertroopers.org's canonical address.
- For donation or partnership enquiries, direct users to the [Donate](/donate) or [Contact](/contact) pages rather than answering financial questions directly.
